meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
If your main concern is **active acne + clogged pores**, I’d buy:

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹313*

**Why:** it combines **2% salicylic acid** (helps unclog pores and treat breakouts) with **5% niacinamide** (helps oil control and post-acne marks). Current listings put it around **₹313–₹536**, comfortably under your ₹700 budget. [sskin.care](https://sskin.care/ingredients/salicylic-acid-products/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Other good choices

| If you have… | Pick | Approx. price |
|---|---|---:|
| **Active acne, blackheads, oily skin** | **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** | ₹313+ |
| **Acne + dark marks/redness** | **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide + Azelaic Acid** | ₹532 |
| **Sensitive skin + acne marks** | **Azelaic acid 10%** | ₹299–₹500 |
| **More comprehensive acne formula** | **Hyphen Acne Defence Daily Serum** | ~₹617 |


### [Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Face Serum with Azelaic Acid]()
*₹532*

Foxtale is particularly interesting if **marks are as much of a problem as active pimples**; its official listing says it targets oil, active acne and dark spots. [foxtale.in](https://foxtale.in/products/niacinamide-clarifying-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My pick:** **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** if you currently have pimples/blackheads; **Foxtale** if the pimples are occasional but you're left with lots of marks.

Start an acne-active serum **2–3 nights/week**, moisturize afterward, and use **SPF 30–50 every morning**. Don't start several acids at once.

If you tell me whether your skin is **oily, dry, combination, or sensitive** and whether you mainly have **pimples, blackheads, or acne marks**, I can narrow it down to **one serum under ₹700**.
